title: Mist Lane
shortDescription: A lane where mist sits at knee height and does not lift.
longDescription:
The lane runs between byre and mere. Mist sits at the knee and does not lift when you ask it to. If the fold-hound still keeps this path, it will look like a dog until it does not.
South is the wool shed. West is the byre. North is the mere.

fixtures.name: Lane Mist
fixtures.lookDescription: Mist at knee height. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The mist is cold and wool-smelling. It does not keep footprints. Hobb told you not to invent a walker from it. If a hound-shape is here, that is a fight, not a story you have to guess.
